blenlib_wasm32_bug_found_fixed.detail: 1/1: path_utils.ExtensionEnsure exposed a REAL ILP32 bug in Blender's path_utils.cc BLI_path_extension_ensure: `a = path_len - 1` with path_len==0 underflows size_t to 0xFFFFFFFF -> +4294967295 in int64_t on wasm32 (loop runs OOB) vs -1 on LP64. Fixed in patch 0006 by casting to signed before subtracting; native LP64 behavior byte-identical. Test now GREEN. The free cross-build oracle did exactly its job.
